section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the findings of a single study on family enterprise advisors. It highlights that advisors with a strong learning orientation are more likely to acquire feedback and exhibit personal bricolage and innovativeness. Proving orientation showed a surprising positive link with adaptive behaviors, despite a negative link with feedback quality. Avoidance orientation was associated with less adaptive behaviors, an effect not explained by feedback quality.
